price_lines: +About $1.55 on average, with no per-seat pricing. Reviews run on Auto by default: Qodo reads each change and matches the review depth to its risk. A small, low-risk change gets a Lite review. Most changes get a Standard review. Complex or high-risk changes get an Extended multi-agent review. Trivial changes are skipped. You pay only for the reviews that run and you can set a fixed depth per repository if you prefer.

-platform that brings automated, context-aware review into your IDE, pull requests, CLI, and Git workflows. It’s built for complex codebases, with context across multi-repos, to surface critical issues early, enforce standards, shorten feedback cycles, and ship better code faster.
